messages:
Ashwin: quick heads-up — planning to enable the dynamic precision profile (hybrid fp16->int8) for generation routes. PR #4321 merged this morning. Target canary audience: canary-int8-0.5 (0.5% traffic). Rolling window 4h. Main metrics to watch: p95 latency, 99th latency, regen rate, and generation quality delta (prompt eval set). Ops runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/quant-rollout :eyes:

Ashwin: toggle command we intend to run (dry-run verified on staging):
```bash
# enable hybrid int8 for canary audience
ff toggle precision.dynamic_profile --set=hybrid-int8 --audience=canary-int8-0.5 --actor=ashwin
# rollback
ff set precision.dynamic_profile off
```

Emily: quick q — embeddings routes must stay fp16, right? don't want drift in embeddings consumers.

Jordan: correct — embeddings pinned with route override. We added `precision.override.embeddings=fp16` in the rollout config. Eval summary attached in PR: gen quality delta ~0.3% (below threshold), p95 latency improved ~12% on canary hosts.

Lee: any GPU memory headroom concerns? int8 should reduce memory, but verify kv cache behavior for long-seq workloads.

Jordan: verified memory on infra perf runs. KV cache still uses same layout; memory usage dropped ~18% for typical seqlen=512, no OOMs in perf cluster. Long seq (2k) needs a small fallback to fp16; we added route-level guard: `seq_len>1024 -> fp16` so large sessions won't be int8.

Sara: Ops ask — what's the flip window? who is paged if we see regen spikes or >1% quality regression?

Ashwin: schedule: Sunday 03:00 UTC. Monitoring window 4h immediate, then 24h watch. Paging: on-call SRE for infra (primary) + eng-ml on-call (secondary). If regen rate >2x baseline or quality delta >1% on golden prompt set, we rollback immediately.

ci-bot: smoke checks (canary-int8-0.5) completed: unit smoke ✅, basic perf smoke ✅, quality sanity smoke ✅. Details: https://ci.redwood/4321/build/17 :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: scheduled maintenance window created: 2034568800-2034572400 UTC. Notification sent to #eng-ops.

Emily: leaving a note — please don't route customer admin endpoints through the canary. We should exclude billing, admin APIs.

Ashwin: good call. added exclusion list: /admin/*, /billing/*, /audit/* to canary config.

Jordan: small operational note: we'll enable debug sampling at 0.05% for first 30m to capture any misdecoded outputs. Data retention 1 week for sampling.

Lee: thumbs if you approve the window and rollback plan? :thumbsup:

Sara: +1 for window and runbook. I'll be online during the window.

Emily: +1, I'll watch quality dashboards.

Jordan: +1 — will keep an eye on perf dashboards and mem stats.

Ashwin: thanks all — flipping at 03:00 UTC Sunday unless anyone raises a block in next 12h. I'll post an ops-check message just before run. :rocket:
